newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica sees 3.5 pct GDP rise in '97 after drop.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica sees 3.5 pct GDP rise in '97 after drop.

text.p: Costa Rica's economy should grow 3.5 percent in 1997, compared with a drop of about 0.8 percent in 1996, Central Bank President Rodrigo Bolanos said on Monday.
"Indicators in recent months show that we are in a growth trend," he said at a news conference.
High world coffee prices and lower hydrocarbon costs have had a positive impact on the economy, he said, making the government optimistic about growth this year.
Bolanes said interest rates in state and private banks were stable between June 1995 and February 1997, when they dropped from 30-32 percent to 25-30 percent.
